a.text: It was a small Iberian town, one that you can't even find on a map or in history books.
When people still lived there, it was called Rocamarea.
The Bishop of Rocamarea raised a young Sankta. A Sankta... growing up here, learning here, and enjoying life to the fullest.
This was a humble and barren place, but well suited for the asceticism of a pious life.
Except after the Profound Silence, life in Iberia was always fragile, no matter how hard people worked.
One plague, one famine, or one premeditated infiltration was all it took to bring everything crashing down.
To save the hometown that, at the same time, was not his hometown, the Sankta arrived in the holy city of Laterano to ask for any amount of support.
The answer he received was simple: You are one of us, but they are not.
When the Sankta returned to Iberia, that 'hometown' had disappeared.
Everything had been completely smoothed over, erased, as if it never existed at all.
Like a grain of sand disappearing into the desert, or a drop of water dissolving into the tide.
After a long journey, the Sankta returned to Laterano an emaciated, lost soul.
He went to the chapel to seek a canonized bishop, in search of answers or guidance.
But even the canonist could only remain silent in the face of such great doubt.
On the pew he sat, remaining there from dawn to dusk.
Fiammetta, that was the first time I met Andoain.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Forget it, I'll pay for it myself. The repairs here cost too much.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: We'll just have to cut back on the afternoon tea and sweets.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Your Holiness! I heard the sound of fighting coming from the Basilica! Are you alright?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: What... You were attacked by heretics?! I'm sorry! I failed in my duties!

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Fret not, Paolario. Did you forget who won the Basilica's last arm wrestling tournament?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: You did.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: I was just exercising my wrist a bit, and ended up causing a bit of an accident.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: The unrest within the city has already subsided.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Yes, they've dispersed. I didn't even get a chance to grill––
Excuse me, can I come in?

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: Ahem, my apologies. Your Holiness, I'm making a fool of myself.

steps.name: Apostolic Knight
steps.text: What I meant was, the ones you asked for are here.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Please come in, my children.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Salutations, Your Holiness...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Good day, Your Holiness. I am Cecelia.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Ah, welcome. You'll have to forgive me for the mess here.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: As for you two...

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: What sweets do you like with tea?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Do you... need me to make something?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Hmm, let me think...

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Maybe add a few cubes of sugar into your teacup?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Ezell, perhaps you should add a few more. Some sweetness will mellow out your nerves.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Ah! Y-Yes...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Your Holiness, if I... wanted to leave Laterano, would you let me go?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: If I said no, would you obey me?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Maybe not.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Then go.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: ...Your Holiness?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: I'm just a poor old man whose greatest wish is to spend the rest of his life in a soft rocking chair. How could I muster the effort to manage a young girl's travel plans?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: But, Cecelia is...

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Is what? Do you still think she's some hybrid of angel and devil, a saint who will usher in the Revelation?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Cecelia is just a little girl who wants to go outside and see the world, is she not?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: You're still carrying your mama's guardian gun, right?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Ah, I'm sorry! Should I leave it with Mister Ezell?

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: But...

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: It's fine, my child.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: The acquisition of a patron firearm is a solemn affair. It is supposed to require a grand ceremony, the presence of a guardian, the approval of a mentor, as well as lots of troublesome paperwork...

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: But, you aren't even of age to obtain a guardian gun. So, just take it with you quietly.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Is that really okay?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: I wouldn't dare say call this my boon to you. Each and every gun is a valuable asset to Laterano.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: But, if this is the only keepsake a child has of her mother, I'm sure no one could oppose that.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Take it with you, my child. You may not have the physical ability to pull the trigger and take out a bad guy... but it will always remind you that wherever you go, your journey began in Laterano.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: ...Okay, thank you, Your Holiness.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Ezell, go with her. Call it your long-term field mission.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Just remember to stop by every now and then.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Do I... really have the right to do that?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Of course you do. Is this not the choice that you made?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I will do everything in my power to fulfill this mission.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Look after Cecelia well.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Alright, now be on your way. Time waits for no man. When you get to be my age, all you think about is taking your next nap.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Pope...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I promise to follow this path to the very end.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: In that case, I will pray for you.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Your Holiness, are you satisfied with this outcome?

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: I got to enjoy some sweets with them. I am satisfied with that.

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: The man has left, just as you instructed.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: Should I have kept him around a bit longer? Maybe a piece of chocolate would've cheered him up?

steps.name: Velliv
steps.text: Your Holiness... you're too soft-hearted.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: No, Velliv, the dream of becoming torches in the cold night is doomed to failure. For all of us.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: But, serving a functionary a hot cup of tea... that's something we can always do.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: 'This world is hostile to beauty...' May those who reject this aphorism find success.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: It is time for us to move on to our next task as well. Now that the riots have subsided, let's convene the foreign envoys.

steps.name: The Pope
steps.text: The Revelation is clear, I will do what I must.

a.text: I often think back to what happened that night.
At first, it was just an ordinary cleanup mission, just another group of Sarkaz raiders.
We tracked them down as they made their escape, and came upon the place.
Unusual, but there were no signs of hostility.
Only... traces of those men locked in their own time.
I received that emergency request for aid... I left you.
I abandoned you.
The distress signal wasn't from very far away. The round trip would be half a day at most.
I even rushed back early...
I remember the mottled texture of the tiles under my feet. I remember the sensation of cold rain falling on my face.
I remember your black horns. And your tightly closed eyes.
And Andoain, who had gone missing.
But... it was just a cleanup mission.
It was just another cleanup mission!!!
Why did it have to happen like that? Where did it all go wrong?
If I had never left... If I had stayed there, if I had been with you, would none of that have happened?
At least... At least it wouldn't have been...
That by the time I arrived, everything was set in stone. It couldn't be undone.
It's an awful feeling. Truly, unbearably awful.
That the only thing I could do was watch...
I should've been there to shoulder the burden alongside all of you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's not true, Fiammetta. You don't have to shoulder anyone's burden.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: No, that is my choice.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I don't care what power he was lusting after, what secrets he was trying to uncover, what answers he was trying to find.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I don't care about his ideals, his lofty cause, who he redeemed, or who he guided.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I will not forgive him.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Not because of my beliefs, not because of Laterano, not because of the Pontifica Cohors, and not even the time that I've lost...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I will not forgive him, because––

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Andoain, you betrayed the people who trusted you.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: My old friends.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: How come you're here in one piece?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: How come even His Holiness can't...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: How come...?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: How come... you're asking me that again... The path was never there in the first place. What good does it do groping around in the nothingness?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Is this your penitence?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Penitence? No, I have nothing to repent... Where can I repent? There is no light, no path. Those who suffer must continue to suffer, those who grieve must continue to grieve.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: There is no salvation, no paradise. This is Laterano, and it is the only thing that belongs to us.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: If the light has always been a lie... No, not a lie... It's real, but not as we wished...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: There has never been a light... let alone illumination...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: What are you babbling about, Andoain?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Have I given up? Why would I be here if I had given up?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: With a barrier this thick, how am I supposed to embrace them? How am I supposed to embrace them?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Maybe I am nothing more than a swindler peddling false hope... who deceived myself into believing it...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I don't understand. What is Its judgment? Where does It want me to go? Its very presence has already blocked my path...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Where shall I find my path?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Andoain! Wake up! Look who's standing in front of you!

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Who... Ahh... Fiammetta...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Why are you losing your mind again?! Where did your honey tongue go, your righteous air? Have you lost your spine?!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: How am I supposed to convict a husk of a madman? Take a good look at who's standing in front of you!

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: ...I'm in Laterano, Fiammetta. I'm above the Basilica.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I'm glad to see you all again... No, I'm not glad at all.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Are you trying to get in the way?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You still dare to get in my way?!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Apologize, Andoain.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Right now. Get on your knees and apologize to Mostima and Lemuen!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Do you think you did nothing wrong?!

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I have made countless mistakes.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You're still pretty damned smug, aren't you?!

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: God forbid.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Listen up, Andoain. I don't give a damn what your beliefs are, nor do I care if all your beliefs have gone to shit.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Lemuen forgave you. Mostima forgave you. Yvangelista XI forgave you. Even if all of Laterano forgives you... I will not.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I'm so sorry, Fiammetta.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'm not the one you should be apologizing to.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: If I had the chance, I'd probably do the same thing all over again.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you for real? You'd say that in front of Fiammetta?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And right now, you're not...

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Very good, Andoain.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Take out your gun.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: You know that won't accomplish anything.

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: You think I care about accomplishing something?! I in malam crucem! You think that if I kill you right here, Lemuen gets eight years of her life back?! Or that Mostima gets the whole rest of hers?!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: Pedicabo ego te et irrumabo! Accomplishing something!

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I want revenge for the sake of getting my goddamned revenge! Do you get that, Andoain?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Are you so completely obsessed, Fiammetta?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: So what if I am?

steps.name: Fiammetta
steps.text: I'll say it one more time, Andoain–– Take out your gun!
